item.name: /login
Setup

request.description: Creates a new admin user with random credentials. Saves the generated email and password to environment variables for use in subsequent login requests.

item.description: Pre-test setup for the login flow. Creates a user with random credentials and saves the email and password to environment variables for use in subsequent login requests.

request.description: Attempts to log in using valid credentials previously stored in environment variables. Expects a 200 response and saves the authorization token to the environment.
Attempts to log in using random invalid credentials. Expects a 401 Unauthorized response with an appropriate error message.
Attempts to log in with empty email and password fields. Expects a 400 Bad Request response with field-level validation error messages.

item.description: Contains all test scenarios for the login endpoint (`/login`). Covers successful authentication, invalid credentials, and empty field validation.

item.name: /user
Setup

request.description: Creates a new admin user with random credentials as part of the test setup. Saves the generated name, email, password, admin flag, and user ID to environment variables for use in subsequent requests.

item.description: Pre-test setup for the user flow. Creates a second admin user with random credentials and saves all generated data (name, email, password, admin flag, and ID) to environment variables for use in subsequent requests.

request.description: Sends a POST request to create a new admin user with random credentials. Expects a 201 status code and a success message. Saves the created user's data (name, email, password, admin flag, and ID) to environment variables for use in subsequent requests.
Attempts to create a new user using an email address that is already registered. Expects a 400 status code and an error message indicating the email is already in use.
Attempts to create a new user with all fields left empty. Expects a 400 status code and validation error messages for each required field (name, email, password, and admin flag).
Retrieves the full list of registered users. Expects a 200 status code and a response body containing a 'quantidade' (count) field and a 'usuarios' array with all user records.

Retrieves a specific user by their ID stored in the 'userId' environment variable. Expects a 200 status code and validates that the returned user data matches the values stored in the environment variables.

item.name: Get User By Id With Nonexistent Id

request.description: Attempts to retrieve a user using a randomly generated, nonexistent ID. Expects a 400 status code and an error message indicating the user was not found.

Sends a PUT request to update the user identified by 'userId' with new random credentials. Expects a 200 status code and a success message. Saves the updated user data to environment variables for subsequent validation.
Retrieves the previously updated user by ID and validates that all fields (name, email, password, admin flag, and ID) match the updated values stored in the environment variables.
Attempts to update a user's email to one that is already registered by another user. Expects a 400 status code and an error message indicating the email is already in use.
Attempts to send a PUT request to the /usuarios/ endpoint without providing a user ID. Expects a 405 status code and an error message indicating that PUT is not allowed on this route.
Sends a DELETE request to remove the user identified by 'userId'. Expects a 200 status code and a success message confirming the record was deleted.

item.name: Validating that user has been deleted

request.description: Attempts to retrieve the previously deleted user by ID. Expects a 400 status code and an error message indicating the user was not found, confirming the deletion was successful.
Attempts to delete a user using a randomly generated, nonexistent ID. Expects a 200 status code and a message indicating that no record was deleted.
Attempts to send a DELETE request to the /usuarios/ endpoint without providing a user ID. Expects a 405 status code and an error message indicating that DELETE is not allowed on this route.

item.description: Contains all test scenarios for the users endpoint (`/usuarios`). Covers user creation, retrieval, update, and deletion, including edge cases such as duplicate emails, nonexistent IDs, and empty fields.

item.name: /products
Setup

request.description: Creates a new admin user with random credentials. Saves the generated email and password to environment variables for use in subsequent login requests.
Attempts to log in using valid credentials previously stored in environment variables. Expects a 200 response and saves the authorization token to the environment.
Creates a new product with random data as part of the test setup. Saves the generated product name and ID to environment variables for use in subsequent requests.

item.description: Pre-test setup for the products flow. Creates an admin user, logs in to obtain an authorization token, and creates an initial product. Saves all generated data to environment variables for use in subsequent requests.

request.description: Sends a POST request to create a new product with random data. Expects a 201 status code and a success message. Saves the created product's name, price, description, quantity, and ID to environment variables for use in subsequent requests.
Attempts to create a new product using a name that is already registered. Expects a 400 status code and an error message indicating the product name is already in use.
Attempts to create a new product with all fields left empty. Expects a 400 status code and validation error messages for each required field (name, price, description, and quantity).
Attempts to create a new product using an empty or invalid authorization token. Expects a 401 Unauthorized response with an appropriate error message.
Retrieves the full list of registered products. Expects a 200 status code and a response body containing a 'quantidade' (count) field and a 'produtos' array with all product records.

Retrieves a specific product by its ID stored in the 'productId' environment variable. Expects a 200 status code and validates that the returned product data matches the values stored in the environment variables.
Attempts to retrieve a product using a randomly generated, nonexistent ID. Expects a 400 status code and an error message indicating the product was not found.

Sends a PUT request to update the product identified by 'productId' with new random data. Expects a 200 status code and a success message. Saves the updated product data to environment variables for subsequent validation.
Retrieves the previously updated product by ID and validates that all fields (name, price, description, quantity, and ID) match the updated values stored in the environment variables.
Attempts to update a product's name to one that is already registered by another product. Expects a 400 status code and an error message indicating the product name is already in use.
Attempts to send a PUT request to the /produtos/ endpoint without providing a product ID. Expects a 405 status code and an error message indicating that PUT is not allowed on this route.
Attempts to update a product using an empty or invalid authorization token. Expects a 401 Unauthorized response with an appropriate error message.
Sends a DELETE request to remove the product identified by 'productId'. Expects a 200 status code and a success message confirming the record was deleted.

item.name: Validating that product has been deleted

request.description: Attempts to retrieve the previously deleted product by ID. Expects a 400 status code and an error message indicating the product was not found, confirming the deletion was successful.
Attempts to delete a product using a randomly generated, nonexistent ID. Expects a 200 status code and a message indicating that no record was deleted.
Attempts to send a DELETE request to the /produtos/ endpoint without providing a product ID. Expects a 405 status code and an error message indicating that DELETE is not allowed on this route.
Attempts to delete a product using an empty or invalid authorization token. Expects a 401 Unauthorized response with an appropriate error message.

item.description: Contains all test scenarios for the products endpoint (`/produtos`). Covers product creation, retrieval, update, and deletion, including edge cases such as duplicate names, nonexistent IDs, empty fields, and invalid authorization tokens.
